class.name: NNBTTaskNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for Noodle Nodes behaviour tree task nodes.
class.description: Provides a [method on_tick] method for task nodes to implement to run their custom logic. Implementations must override [method on_tick]; the default returns [code]Status.FAILURE[/code]. Scripts may also implement the optional lifecycle hooks [method on_before_run], [method on_after_run] and [method on_interrupt]. They receive the [param delta] of the run they belong to. A script may omit any of them; the hooks are simply not called when they are not defined.

method.name: on_before_run
method.description: Optional hook called exactly once when a run starts, before the first [method on_tick] of that run. May be omitted by scripts.

method.name: on_after_run
method.description: Optional hook called exactly once when a run ends with [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code]. It is not called for an interrupted run. May be omitted by scripts.

method.name: on_interrupt
method.description: Optional hook called exactly once when an active run is abandoned, for example because the node was disabled, reset or explicitly interrupted. The [param delta] is that of the interrupted run. May be omitted by scripts.

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Logic to be executed each tick. The node's data lives in the nearest [NNBTRoot] blackboard, reachable with the [NNBTNodes] blackboard helpers, and the actor is available with [method NNBTNodes.get_actor]. Must return one of [code]SKIP[/code] (-2), [code]FAILURE[/code] (-1), [code]RUNNING[/code] (0) or [code]SUCCESS[/code] (1). Task nodes that use the return value report any other type or value as an engine error naming the node and handle it as [code]FAILURE[/code].
